source: Saved attack results; no new attacks or device inference.

qnn_htp_v1.runtime: Qualcomm QNN, libQnnHtp.so, QCS6490, uint8 I/O

limitations: QNN is V1 based; V2 runtime differences cannot be attributed to backend or precision alone.
The V1 control here uses resize 232, not the original resize-256 V1 experiment (83 clean-correct).
QNN image alignment was reconstructed from its saved seed and current sampler; no independent QNN image-hash manifest was saved at attack time.
QNN and V1 have no additional 100-step/five-start survivor run; baseline PGD already evaded all 89 at 1/255.
QNN BPDA uses V1 surrogate gradients and actual device forward scores; it is not native QNN autograd.
The Square success plateau and coarse output grid do not isolate a causal mechanism; no QNN tie-frequency trace or quantizer ablation was recorded.
The 100-image ten-class one-seed pilot does not establish a general robustness ranking.
